purpose: Provide the non-author documentary approval required by MATHSOLVE rules for mechanically generated ERDOS blind-cohort closure pull requests.
authority_source: existing GCL Council Clerk GitHub App; short-lived MATHSOLVE-only token
required_preconditions: branch name matches the registered ERDOS cohort-closure pattern
Programme protected validator re-establishes the candidate against current protected MATHSOLVE evidence
candidate branch differs from main by exactly one registered closure JSON artifact
ordinary PR is authored by gcl-release-trust[bot]
PR targets main and exact head matches the validated candidate head
allowed_action: submit one exact-head APPROVE review documenting mechanical closure only
prohibited_actions: mutate campaign state beyond documentary review
bypass repository rules or administrator controls
idempotency_rule: If an exact-head Council Clerk approval already exists, record ALREADY_APPROVED and perform no mutation.
claim_boundary: Approval means only that the closure receipt is documentary/mechanical and satisfies the protected closure validator. It has no mathematical, literature, certification, publication, prize, or parent-problem effect.

live_qualification.interpretation: No closure PR was open at qualification time. The protected workflow, credentials, Programme/MATHSOLVE checkouts, validator import, candidate scan, report preservation, and zero-candidate idempotent path all executed successfully.
